3 minutes in the dark.

No flashlight. No phone signal. Hands searching the wall.

That is how long before panic sets in.

A compact EDC flashlight weighs 2oz. Fits in your pocket. Costs less than your last coffee run.

When the grid goes down, it is the first thing you reach for.

What is your go-to light? Drop it below.
